item.title: Women Rally Against War in Chiang Mai
item.description: More than 300 women’s rights activists marched at Chiang Mai University (CMU) on March 8 to mark International Women’s Day, chanting: “War! What is it good for? Nothing! WOW.” The slogan “WOW” stands for Women Oppose War, highlighting the movement’s message that women stand against war and violence.
